Name: Discoveries In The Depths
Author: mikeInside
Description:
[size=4][b]:: REQUIRED MODS ::[/b][/size]

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5966][b]Custom Ore Nodes[/b][/url]
https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5966
This is so that small discoveries can replace the default stones, delete [font=Courier New][CON]TinyDiscoveries[/font] if you don't want this.

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6669][b]Custom Resource Clumps [/b][/url]
https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6669
This is so that large discoveries can replace the default boulders, delete [font=Courier New][CRC]BigDiscoveries[/font] if you don't want this.

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5894][b]Custom Dungeon Floors[/b][/url]
https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5894
This one is not required, but without it most floors will will not have boulders and thus no chance of finding a large discovery. Open the config.json file and find "ResourceClumpChance", I suggest changing it from 0.005 to 0.025 to make boulders 5 times more frequent. If you don't want to edit the config file, you can find a replacement for it within this mod located here:
[font=Courier New]DiscoveriesInTheDepths\[CRC]BigDiscoveries\CustomRarity\CustomMonsterFloors[/font]

[b]
[size=4][b]:: COMPATIBILITY ::[/b][/size]
[/b]
Can be added/removed from existing save games with no problems. Should be compatible with anything as long as it is not making changes to rocks and boulders in the mines, have not found any problems after using it with 130 other mods simultaneously. Other content packs for Custom Ore Nodes/Custom Resource Clumps can be used at the same time, though they may significantly reduce the chances of finding discoveries.

[b]
[size=4]:: DISCOVERY RARITY ::[/size][/b]

You can easily change how often you'll come across a discovery, there are 7 presets to choose from: VeryRare, Rare, Uncommon, Default, Abundant, Overpowered, and Ridiculous. Go to
[font=Courier New]DiscoveriesInTheDepths\[CRC]BigDiscoveries\CustomRarity[/font]
Choose your preferred setting, and copy the two folders within to the main [font=Courier New]DiscoveriesInTheDepths[/font] folder, overwriting files.

With the default settings, you should find something new every few levels in the mines. Rarer and more valuable discoveries are more likely to be found deeper in the mines and in the Skull Cavern.

[b]
[size=4]:: EXTRA CUSTOMISATION ::[/size][/b]

If you are on a Windows computer you can edit everything about this mod (for personal use) using Excel.
Open [font=Courier New]OreDetails.xlsx[/font] located in [font=Courier New]DiscoveriesInTheDepths\[CRC]BigDiscoveries\[/font]
Once you have finished, save the file and right-click on [font=Courier New]OreDetailsExport.ps1[/font], choosing "[font=Courier New]Run with Powershell[/font]" to generate new JSON files. You can also edit [font=Courier New]OreDetailsExport.ps1[/font] with a text editor if you would like to change the rarity settings.
If you do not have Windows/Excel, you can still customise the mod by editing [font=Courier New]custom_ore_nodes.json[/font] and [font=Courier New]custom_resource_clumps.json[/font] with a text editor.



Big thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/18901754]aedenthorn[/url] for writing the frameworks to make this mod possible.

Downloads.Description: 1.0.4 Bug fix for rainbow items. Rebalancing to make mid-range discoveries more likely & less repetitive. Increased randomness & less overall value from sapling/egg/fairy drops.
